sections.name: BEFORE STARTING THIS PROGRAM BE SURE TO COMPLETE ALL 8 WEEKS OF ENDLESS ENGINE FIRST.

items.movement: After finishing Endless Engine, you should have a solid grasp of how the programming works and how to approach each workout mentally. For that reason, this course doesn’t include extra videos or coaching content. If you’re ever unsure, refer back to the main Endless Engine course for guidance.
While you’re free to complete the tracks in any order, we highly recommend starting with your weakest area (based on your final Endless Engine results) and working toward your strongest.
Just a reminder — only tackle only one 8-week section at a time. 😉
Some days will be tough, but we’re confident you’ll come out of this a stronger, more well-rounded athlete.
Need help? Feel free to reach out to support@wodprep.com or, if you’re a WODprep Academy athlete, post your questions in the Academy Coaching space with the topic ‘Engine’.

sections.format: Congratulations on completing “Endless Engine” and graduating to the Endless Engine | Specific Programming course! This next phase is designed to help you continue building your cardio engine while targeting specific weaknesses.

workouts.title: Download Your Tracking Sheet
workouts.description: With each modality, we'll have new numbers and paces to track. With the Air Bike, we'll be testing the 50cal Air Bike Sprint and 30min Max Calorie bike. Day 3 will be reserved for mix modals work as those days will help improve our pacing, breathing as we move between different exercises. With the Row, we'll be testing the 500m Row Sprint, 5km Row for Time and a WOD of 27-21-15-9 Rower Cals & Burpees over the Rower, which is a renowned Coach CJ testing WOD. Note, that there is an extra week built into the Row Programming so we can space out the last week of testing, so you can maximize your recovery and performance. Lastly, with the Run programming, we'll test the 800m Time Trial, 3000m (3km) Run for Time to set our working paces, as well as the classic Girls' WOD, "Helen"! For kicks, we'll also add in a Mile Run Time Trial in week 8 to see how all that aerobic capacity work has paid off in this classic distance. To make tracking easier, we prepared a Specific Programming tracking Sheet that you can download in the Files tab.

sections.name: RUN | TEST WEEK • WORKOUT 1 (0.1)

items.movement: Both 800m sets should be ran for the best time possible.
Careful not to over-pace, goal is to push hard as possible for each interval.

sections.notes: Record both 800m times w/ 400m split times. Also, find your overall average 400m split time by adding the 2 800m times together and dividing by 4.

sections.name: RUN | TEST WEEK • WORKOUT 2 (0.2)

items.movement: Like the 5km test in Endless Engine, map out the run before you start and revisit the same route when you retest this distance in Week 9.

sections.notes: Aim for a smooth effort while aiming to increase your split every 1000m.
